# UltraHive

> UltraHive is a premium hexagonal falling-block puzzle by Ripsaw LLC. $2.99 one-time, no ads, no in-app purchases, on iPhone and Android.

Pieces drop onto a neon 11-column honeycomb and rotate in 60-degree steps. A hold piece and a ghost preview are included. Color chains of 8 or more cells clear. Classic mode has 25 intensity levels and five power-ups: place anywhere, clear a row, slow time, flip gravity, and shrink to a single hex. Hive Bits is 28 handcrafted puzzles with walls, moths, bee allies, and honey.

The iOS app launched on 2026-02-24. Version 1.6.0 was released on 2026-07-23. Game Center is used for leaderboards only. Family Sharing is available on Apple. Android has been on Google Play since 2026-09-10 and is fully offline. Scores and coins stay on the device. UltraHive does not collect personal data.

No rating, review count, award, or download total is stated on this site.
